scope: One finite observation-only local native diagnostic; no grasp, contact-model correction or idle success claim

budget.policy: Same full300 source, no reduced scene, sweep, reset, post-initialization state writes or retry loop. This does not reset the existing three-round stage budget.
budget.capacity_semantics: 1024 entries per direct tensor contact view, including its documented normal/friction buffers; record actual capacity returned by each API.
budget.API_adaptation_policy: At most one reviewed source/snapshot correction after an explicit API setup/argument error before postassembly step1. Preserve failed setup. No adaptation from contact values, breakage, trajectory or physics feedback; no second postassembly observation run. Reassess if collection fails after stepping.

baseline.note: Default coupled OSQP_EPSILON=1e-4. The1e-6 pair is contextual evidence, not a new physical baseline.

unchanged_settings.physical_breakage_fields: Every public breakage field equals baseline1733; debug_dump=True is reporting only. Compare assembly thresholds too; automatic assembly stays disabled and breakage enabled.
unchanged_settings.geometry: Same300 source bodies/301 parts/930 links, stock collisions, masses/inertia/materials/transforms/gravity, native connection frames and initial state.
unchanged_settings.control: Same nominal arm/finger joint targets and actuator setup; no task motion, force command or pose correction.
disallowed: deleting clutches or suppressing break detection

instrumentation.api: Direct PhysX tensor contact view; record exact installed API/version/return semantics. Do not use convenience wrappers that silently change stabilization or physics settings.
instrumentation.reporters: Reuse existing contact reporters and thresholds; record setup and assert no reporter threshold/shape edits.

process_local_setting.status: Explicitly potentially perturbing reporting/processing setting; record before/after. Equivalence must be measured, never assumed.

instrumentation.coverage: All contact partners for every watched body, including other bricks, robot, table and nonLEGO assets. Same connected-component LEGO contact suppression/refiltering must be recorded; internal zero cannot exclude external contacts.
instrumentation.capacity_policy: 1024 entries per view. Record allocated capacity, active counts/start indices, truncation/overflow/backend warnings. At capacity or without demonstrable completeness, label contact completeness unknown. Do not silently increase capacity and rerun.
instrumentation.positive_control: Record any independently justified positive reporting/control contact within existing unchanged scene and why it should be observable. Do not invent a contact or create a new collider. Without a positive control, contact-stream completeness remains UNKNOWN, including when all sensors return zero. An unbroken native clutch is not a positive PhysX contact-report control.

timing_frames_units.step0: After existing initialization/manual native preassembly, before any postassembly step. Preassembly/stale contact buffers are not current observations.
timing_frames_units.per_step: Record step index, sim time before and after sim.step, actual dt, scene.update/read order, native dump sequence and source/robot snapshots. Stop at first baseline failure condition.
timing_frames_units.association: Pair contact data with same-step native J/H and world COM only when timestamp/order convention is supported; otherwise time_alignment_unknown.
timing_frames_units.units: Record whether API returns forces or impulses and its dt convention. Convert documented force output to impulse with actual step dt only; no guessed unit conversion.
timing_frames_units.coordinates: Record world/local frame and sensor body/filter shape ordering for normals, normal scalar, friction vectors and points. Preserve raw arrays and path/index maps.
timing_frames_units.normal_sign: Use primary installed API contract and available reciprocal watched-body contacts. If sign/body orientation is unresolved, retain magnitudes but do not claim a signed wrench.
timing_frames_units.friction: Keep friction patch points separate from normal points; no per-point pairing unless API explicitly provides it. Unknown or unreported tangent data is not zero.
timing_frames_units.COM: Use same-step actual world COM, not body-bottom/root position. Record pre/poststep convention and native COM correspondence; unresolved COM/time invalidates signed moment comparison.

derived_metrics.normal_impulse: Per watched body Jn=sum(jn*n), using documented body-force normal sign.
derived_metrics.tangential_impulse: Per watched body Jt=sum(jt), using actual available tangential vectors and documented frame.
derived_metrics.moments: Sum cross(contact_point-COM,normal_impulse) and cross(friction_point-COM,tangential_impulse) separately, in world frame. Do not double-count reciprocal body rows.
derived_metrics.aggregate_check: Compare per-point sums to API aggregates only where their documented force/impulse/friction semantics match; record discrepancy rather than force agreement.
derived_metrics.native_comparison: Same-run contact impulses and moments may be compared descriptively with native J/H only after unit/frame/time/sign/completeness gates. J/H minus nominal gravity is not an independent contact sensor; weld/damping/gyroscopic/accounting and unlogged terms may remain.
derived_metrics.interpretation: Contact contribution/accounting evidence only. Convergence, empty streams or near-boundary utilization do not establish physical overload, numerical error, stability, extraction or calibrated force sensing.

equivalence_tolerances.native_threshold_comparison: Exact serialized public values, apart from debug-reporting metadata already enabled in reference.
equivalence_tolerances.state_coverage: Compare initial and same terminal-step301body states, and all baseline-available per-step global drift/speed/q metrics. Do not claim complete per-body trajectories if baseline lacks those intermediate states.
equivalence_tolerances.breakage: Exact first failure step and endpoint pair set; connection IDs must match recorded mapping or explicitly report identity/mapping difference.
equivalence_tolerances.outcome: Any mismatch, premature instrumentation failure, missing comparison states or changed break timing is an instrumentation perturbation/unverified equivalence. Do not use it as a causal explanation of the original baseline.

completion.diagnostic_completed: Collection/reporting finished within declared budget; missing observations remain explicitly unknown.
completion.report: Preserve source/config/API/setup/protocol hashes and raw contact counts/streams, state equivalence, native event identities, per-body normal/tangent impulses/moments, applicable gates and unmeasured terms. Do not recommend a physical parameter change from one diagnostic alone.
